podcast.title: Breast Cancer Diagnosis and Treatment (2007)
podcast.body: In 2007, a lump was discovered in her breast. She underwent a lumpectomy, chemotherapy, and radiation treatments to battle the cancer. "In 2007, a lump was discovered in her breast. She underwent chemo, a lumpectumine, and radiation treatments."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Marriage Breakdown (2007)
podcast.body: The arduous ordeal of her cancer diagnosis and treatment took a significant toll on her personal life, ultimately leading to the dissolution of her marriage. "The ordeal took a toll on her marriage, and she and her husband broke up."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Anorexia and Health Issues on Tour
podcast.body: Maintaining a proper vegan diet on tour was challenging, leading her to eat very little. This resulted in her becoming extremely thin (wearing size zero clothes) and she later confessed to likely having been anorexic, experiencing amenorrhea for ten years, night sweats, and anxiety. "she ate very little, making her even tinier and sliter than she was. All her clothes were a size zero, and she confesses that she might have been anorexic."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Breast Cancer Advocacy
podcast.body: After successfully battling breast cancer, Biff Naked made a comeback in music and also became an advocate and activist for other breast cancer patients. "she's back making music and working as an advocate and activist for breast cancer patients."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Breast Cancer Diagnosis and Recovery
podcast.body: In 2008, Biff Naked was diagnosed with breast cancer, a challenge she successfully overcame after undergoing extensive chemotherapy. This personal battle significantly shaped her life and subsequent work. "in 2008 she was diagnosed with breast cancer however she did manage to beat that after lots of chemotherapy."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Current Life and Performances
podcast.body: As of the transcript, Biff Naked resides in Toronto with her third husband and continues to perform live while maintaining her official website, biffnaked.com. This demonstrates her ongoing musical presence and personal stability. "today she's living in Toronto with her third husband and continues to perform live as well as maintain her website at biffnaked.com."

podcast.title: Diverse Media and Humanitarian Work
podcast.body: Beyond her music, Biff Naked appeared on television shows like *Buffy the Vampire Slayer* and *The L Word*, voiced cartoons, acted in movies, engaged in various humanitarian projects, and pursued writing and poetry. This illustrates her multifaceted artistic and social contributions. "She appeared on TV including in an episode of Buffy the Vampire Slaver and on the L word. She voiced cartoon she was cast in movies worked on various humanitarian projects pursued work as both a writer and a poet and other things."

podcast.title: Early Stomach Issues and Veganism
podcast.body: As a young woman, Biff Naked experienced stomach problems. She adopted a hardcore vegan diet in response to the unhealthy habits of the rock and roll lifestyle. "When she was young, Biff suffered from some stomach issues. She fought against the bad-edin habits of the rock and roll lifestyle and became a hardcore vegan."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Extensive Live Performance History
podcast.body: Biff Naked maintained an active touring career, performing alongside internationally recognized acts such as the Foo Fighters, The Smashing Pumpkins, Green Day, and Snoop Dogg. She also appeared in The Offspring's "The Kids Aren't Alright" music video, showcasing broad industry engagement. "she had a great live run too performing with everyone from the food fighters and the smashing pumpkins to Green Day and Snoop Dogg and if you know the offspring video the kids aren't all right she's in that one."

podcast.title: Memoir Release
podcast.body: Her experiences, particularly with breast cancer, led her to write a memoir titled *I Bificus*, sharing the title with one of her albums. This book provided a personal account of her journey. "That led to a memoir entitled I Bificus yes the same as the album."

podcast.title: Origin of Stage Name
podcast.body: The name "Biff Naked" originated from two separate events: she was called "Biff" since grade eight, and the "Naked" part was added by a bandmate in her punk band Gorilla Gorilla while she was studying drama at the University of Winnipeg, inspired by a friend who was a stripper. "She's been called Biff since she was in grade eight. The naked part came when she was in a punk band called Gorilla Gorilla."
